content.short: Solidcheck is an automated vulnerability testing platform for Solidity smart contracts.
content.description: Solidcheck delivers automated vulnerability testing for Solidity smart contracts, spotting weaknesses, vulnerabilities, and attack vectors before they cause harm. You can add contracts by uploading files directly, linking from GitHub, or via a mainnet explorer, making it easy to weave security checks into your workflow. This streamlined tool helps developers, investors, and businesses focus on growth with greater confidence in the safety and integrity of their smart contracts.
